response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), s AS (SELECT region, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM r), a AS (SELECT region, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_clients, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share
